_comment: First-sale launch scope (founder decision 3, 21 Nov 2026). Enforced by lib/launchScope.js in api/checkout.js (GET and POST) and in lib/fulfilment.js (a paid session outside the scope is withheld, not fulfilled). It narrows what may be sold; it never widens anything: saleApproved (config/products.json) and the tax policy (config/tax-policy.json) still gate live sales on their own. Changing this file is a founder decision recorded in the pull request.
